description: Status of the user’s custom voices: sentences recorded vs. minimum, consent, recording link, training progress, ready. Without order_id lists them. Free. Training takes hours: do not poll in a loop.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

order_id.description: Voice order id from create_voice or voice_status.
